notes.title: Gloom 1.0.3205 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33752971/8112eaf8c2efcae5eb72804badee7ac94cf55a80.jpg[/img]

Hello Gloomizens, 

Change is good! And with the launch of Gloom: Digital Edition on iOS and Android we’re sending an update that will see some big, exciting changes to the game so that it runs similarly on all platforms! 

We’ve been listening and reading everyone’s feedback and have been working on bug/UI fixes and general updates to the game’s infrastructure. 

Please read below for all changes in update 2.0 

[list]
[*] Updated UI (to coincide with mobile versions)
[*] Improved opponent AI
[*] Fixed multiplayer bugs related to stability
[/list]

As you’ll notice, the biggest change will be a fresh coat of paint to the overall UI. The new UI is now the same across the board, matching up with the upcoming iOS and Android versions. 

The new UI includes
[list]
[*] One family on screen
[*] Discard, Skip and Exit buttons moved to lower right
[*] Timer and active player name moved to top middle of screen
[/list]

These new changes will allow us to seamlessly update and make improvements across all three platforms, while adding some visual improvements requested by the community. 

We hope you love the new digs. Now go spread some Gloom!!

notes.title: Gloom 1.0.3047 update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33752971/8112eaf8c2efcae5eb72804badee7ac94cf55a80.jpg[/img]

Hail and well met!

Believe it or not but following Gloom’s release the studio was attacked by a hornet's nest, then everyone fell into mass depression.

We've still gotten to read your feedback and have been working to improve the game’s AI and iron a few bugs here and there.
You will find the list of changes for this version below!

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Enemy AI has been drastically improved
[*] Cyrillic and Chinese characters are now supported
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] "And the Vacant Vault" now plays correctly
[*] "Out with the Old" now plays correctly
[*] Fixed a discarding timing issue
[*] Fixed a crash that occured while offline but in the main menu
[*] The active opponent's family now correctly displays when it's their turn
[*] Fixed a bug where the credits did not close correctly
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented some players from joining password protected games
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Asmodee.net logins with special characters from being entered
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the cursor to disappear
[/list]

Now we will fade away into oblivion and try to find a reason to live...but eh, your support and feedback could almost be one!

Thanks again from the bottom of our graves.
